business_summary: Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. provides shipping logistics services in China. It provides shipping logistics services, including dry bulk shipping, shipping agency, freight forwarding, comprehensive shipping, special large-scale transportation, ship leasing, crew labor services, etc. The company was formerly known as Chang Jiang Shipping Group Phoenix Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. in September 2023. Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Wuhan, China.
business_summary_ko: Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.는 중국에서 운송 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 건화물 운송, 운송 대행, 화물 운송, 종합 운송, 특수 대규모 운송, 선박 임대, 승무원 노동 서비스 등을 포함한 운송 물류 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 이전에 Chang Jiang Shipping Group Phoenix Co.,Ltd로 알려졌으며 2023년 9월에 Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Phoenix Shipping (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.는 1992년에 설립되었으며 중국 우한에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
